Image 1 is the approved Q-style target for this game: a super-deformed chibi figure about two and a half heads tall, with an enormous head at roughly 45 percent of the figure height, huge round expressive eyes, short stubby limbs, oversized hands and feet, a very thick dark ink outline, flat 2-tone cel shading, one key light from the upper-left, and a fixed three-quarter view from above. The game is set in a MEDIEVAL world: wool, linen, leather, hand-forged iron, rough wood, hand-made and a little battered.

TASK: Draw ONE new creature for the same game in exactly that same Q-style, same medieval world and same camera. Match Image 1's proportions, outline weight, shading and level of detail precisely.

SUBJECT: a restless spirit called a shade - a medieval revenant in a tattered monk's cowl. Cute-spooky, like a cartoon ghost from a storybook. ONE big round head taking up most of the creature, in a deep rust-crimson cowl of coarse torn wool, hanging in loose folds. Inside the hood a black void with two big glowing pale eyes and a tiny wicked grin. Below, a short tattered robe hem that frays and tapers to a floating point - no legs, no feet. Two short stubby arms in ragged sleeves ending in chunky little clawed hands, held out to the sides.

SILHOUETTE: about as WIDE as it is TALL, filling a roughly square area. The big head and the outstretched stubby arms give it the width. It must read as a clear, simple, rounded shape at 51 pixels tall on screen.

MEDIEVAL DETAIL: coarse torn wool with visible fraying, a frayed rope belt, dull bone-coloured trim, a couple of small spooky wisps of cloth trailing off the hem. Deep rust-crimson and blackened-brown cloth with bone-white trim.

TECHNICAL OUTPUT: square, TRANSPARENT background (real alpha channel), single isolated creature, centred, small even margin on all sides.

EXCLUDE: modern clothing, plastic, neon, a tall thin shape, a narrow column, long limbs, realistic proportions, cast shadows on the ground, ground plane, scenery, props, other characters, text, labels, UI, frames, watermark, signature, cropped limbs.
